judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7511, the Laken Riley Act, which required federal detention of immigrants charged with burglary, theft, larceny, or shoplifting. It passed the House 251-170.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7511, the Laken Riley Act, which required federal detention of immigrants charged with burglary, theft, larceny, or shoplifting. It passed the House 251-170.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S. 3853, the Radiation Exposure Compensation Reauthorization Act, which renewed and widened compensation for people who developed illness after exposure to nuclear testing fallout or uranium mining. It passed the Senate 69-30.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S. 3853, the Radiation Exposure Compensation Reauthorization Act, which renewed and widened compensation for people who developed illness after exposure to nuclear testing fallout or uranium mining. It passed the Senate 69-30.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 2799, the Expanding Access to Capital Act, which loosened securities regulation for smaller companies, brokers, and advisers and widened who may invest in private offerings. It passed the House 212-205.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 2799, the Expanding Access to Capital Act, which loosened securities regulation for smaller companies, brokers, and advisers and widened who may invest in private offerings. It passed the House 212-205.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1121, the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which barred the President from declaring a moratorium on hydraulic fracturing without authorization from Congress. It passed the House 229-188.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1121, the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which barred the President from declaring a moratorium on hydraulic fracturing without authorization from Congress. It passed the House 229-188.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 6009, the Restoring American Energy Dominance Act, which forced the Bureau of Land Management to withdraw its rule raising bonding requirements and tightening the oil and gas leasing process on federal land. It passed the House 216-200.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 6009, the Restoring American Energy Dominance Act, which forced the Bureau of Land Management to withdraw its rule raising bonding requirements and tightening the oil and gas leasing process on federal land. It passed the House 216-200.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7023, the Creating Confidence in Clean Water Permitting Act, which narrowed Clean Water Act permitting requirements, limited water quality criteria, and shortened the window to challenge discharge permits. It passed the House 213-205.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7023, the Creating Confidence in Clean Water Permitting Act, which narrowed Clean Water Act permitting requirements, limited water quality criteria, and shortened the window to challenge discharge permits. It passed the House 213-205.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1023, the Cutting Green Corruption and Taxes Act, which repealed the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund and the methane emissions fee created by the Inflation Reduction Act. It passed the House 209-204.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1023, the Cutting Green Corruption and Taxes Act, which repealed the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund and the methane emissions fee created by the Inflation Reduction Act. It passed the House 209-204.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.J.Res. 61, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Federal Highway Administration rule requiring states to measure and set targets for greenhouse gas emissions from the national highway system. It passed the Senate 53-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S.J.Res. 61, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Federal Highway Administration rule requiring states to measure and set targets for greenhouse gas emissions from the national highway system. It passed the Senate 53-47.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to send H.J.Res. 98 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the National Labor Relations Board rule making it easier to treat two companies, such as a franchisor and its franchisee, as joint employers. It passed the Senate 50-48.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 98 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the National Labor Relations Board rule making it easier to treat two companies, such as a franchisor and its franchisee, as joint employers. It passed the Senate 50-48.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 4639, the Fourth Amendment Is Not For Sale Act, which barred law enforcement and intelligence agencies from buying Americans' personal data from brokers instead of obtaining a warrant. It passed the House 219-199.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 4639, the Fourth Amendment Is Not For Sale Act, which barred law enforcement and intelligence agencies from buying Americans' personal data from brokers instead of obtaining a warrant. It passed the House 219-199.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S. 4072, which would have blocked the EPA from enforcing its multi-pollutant tailpipe standards for model year 2027 and later light and medium duty vehicles. It fell short of the 60 votes needed, 52-46.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S. 4072, which would have blocked the EPA from enforcing its multi-pollutant tailpipe standards for model year 2027 and later light and medium duty vehicles. It fell short of the 60 votes needed, 52-46.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 3602, which created criminal penalties for acting as a lookout or otherwise interfering with border enforcement on behalf of a smuggling organization. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 215-199.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 3602, which created criminal penalties for acting as a lookout or otherwise interfering with border enforcement on behalf of a smuggling organization. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 215-199.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 3397, the WEST Act, which forced the Bureau of Land Management to withdraw its public lands rule putting conservation on equal footing with grazing, drilling, and other uses. It passed the House 212-202.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 3397, the WEST Act, which forced the Bureau of Land Management to withdraw its public lands rule putting conservation on equal footing with grazing, drilling, and other uses. It passed the House 212-202.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 615, the Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act, which barred the Interior and Agriculture Departments from restricting lead ammunition or fishing tackle on most federal land and water. It passed the House 214-201.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 615, the Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act, which barred the Interior and Agriculture Departments from restricting lead ammunition or fishing tackle on most federal land and water. It passed the House 214-201.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 764, the Trust the Science Act, which directed the Interior Department to remove the gray wolf from the Endangered Species Act list and barred courts from reviewing that decision. It passed the House 209-205.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 764, the Trust the Science Act, which directed the Interior Department to remove the gray wolf from the Endangered Species Act list and barred courts from reviewing that decision. It passed the House 209-205.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 3195, the Superior National Forest Restoration Act, which lifted the twenty-year mining ban on Forest Service land in the Boundary Waters watershed in Minnesota. It passed the House 212-203.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 3195, the Superior National Forest Restoration Act, which lifted the twenty-year mining ban on Forest Service land in the Boundary Waters watershed in Minnesota. It passed the House 212-203.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 6285, Alaska's Right to Produce Act, which reinstated cancelled oil and gas leases in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and required new lease sales on the coastal plain. It passed the House 214-199.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 6285, Alaska's Right to Produce Act, which reinstated cancelled oil and gas leases in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and required new lease sales on the coastal plain. It passed the House 214-199.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 6192, the Hands Off Our Home Appliances Act, which barred the Department of Energy from tightening efficiency standards for home appliances unless it could show the new standards would save consumers money. It passed the House 212-195.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 6192, the Hands Off Our Home Appliances Act, which barred the Department of Energy from tightening efficiency standards for home appliances unless it could show the new standards would save consumers money. It passed the House 212-195.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 109, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the SEC accounting guidance requiring firms that hold customers' crypto assets to carry them on their own balance sheets. It passed the House 228-182.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 109, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the SEC accounting guidance requiring firms that hold customers' crypto assets to carry them on their own balance sheets. It passed the House 228-182.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 2925, the Mining Regulatory Clarity Act, which let mining operators use federal land for roads, waste disposal, and other support activities even where no valuable mineral deposit has been found. It passed the House 216-195.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 2925, the Mining Regulatory Clarity Act, which let mining operators use federal land for roads, waste disposal, and other support activities even where no valuable mineral deposit has been found. It passed the House 216-195.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7530, the DC CRIMES Act, which stripped the District of Columbia of authority to reduce criminal sentences and lowered the maximum age for youth offender sentencing. It passed the House 225-181.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7530, the DC CRIMES Act, which stripped the District of Columbia of authority to reduce criminal sentences and lowered the maximum age for youth offender sentencing. It passed the House 225-181.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7343, which made assaulting a law enforcement officer a ground for detaining and deporting an immigrant. It passed the House 265-148.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7343, which made assaulting a law enforcement officer a ground for detaining and deporting an immigrant. It passed the House 265-148.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to send H.J.Res. 109 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the SEC accounting guidance requiring firms that hold customers' crypto assets to carry them on their own balance sheets. It passed the Senate 60-38.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 109 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the SEC accounting guidance requiring firms that hold customers' crypto assets to carry them on their own balance sheets. It passed the Senate 60-38.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 354, the LEOSA Reform Act, which let qualified active and retired law enforcement officers carry concealed firearms in school zones, national parks, and certain federal buildings open to the public. It passed the House 221-185.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 354, the LEOSA Reform Act, which let qualified active and retired law enforcement officers carry concealed firearms in school zones, national parks, and certain federal buildings open to the public. It passed the House 221-185.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.J.Res. 58, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer furnaces. It passed the Senate 50-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S.J.Res. 58, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer furnaces. It passed the Senate 50-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 5403, the CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act, which barred the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency or holding accounts for individuals. It passed the House 216-192.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 5403, the CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act, which barred the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency or holding accounts for individuals. It passed the House 216-192.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 192, which barred non-citizens from voting in District of Columbia elections and repealed the DC law that had allowed noncitizen residents to vote in local races. It passed the House 262-143.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 192, which barred non-citizens from voting in District of Columbia elections and repealed the DC law that had allowed noncitizen residents to vote in local races. It passed the House 262-143.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8282, the Illegitimate Court Counteraction Act, which imposed sanctions on foreign nationals who help the International Criminal Court investigate or prosecute Americans or citizens of allied countries that have not accepted the court's jurisdiction. It passed the House 247-155.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8282, the Illegitimate Court Counteraction Act, which imposed sanctions on foreign nationals who help the International Criminal Court investigate or prosecute Americans or citizens of allied countries that have not accepted the court's jurisdiction. It passed the House 247-155.
